title: Workspaces
description: The workspaces module displays the workspaces of the Umbriel compositor.

placeholders.description: 1-based index of the workspace on its output.
Output where the workspace is located.
The workspace layout: scrolling, dwindle, master, or stacking.
Concatenated representation of windows in the workspace, using window-rewrite rules and format-window-separator.

all-outputs.label: All outputs
all-outputs.doc: If set to false, workspaces will only be shown on the output they are on. If set to true all workspaces will be shown on every output.
all-outputs.description: If set to false, workspaces will only be shown on the output they are on. If set to true all workspaces will be shown on every output.

sort-by-name.label: Sort by name
sort-by-name.doc: Sort workspaces by name (numeric sort when all names are numbers). Unnamed workspaces fall back to their index on the output.
sort-by-name.description: Sort workspaces by name (numeric sort when all names are numbers). Unnamed workspaces fall back to their index on the output.

sort-by-id.label: Sort by ID
sort-by-id.doc: Sort workspaces by their stable id. Takes precedence over sort-by-name.
sort-by-id.description: Sort workspaces by their stable id. Takes precedence over sort-by-name.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the workspace name, index and state, the corresponding icon gets selected. See ICONS.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

disable-click.label: Disable click
disable-click.doc: If set to false, you can click to change workspace. If set to true this behaviour is disabled.
disable-click.description: If set to false, you can click to change workspace. If set to true this behaviour is disabled.

enable-bar-scroll.label: Enable bar scroll
enable-bar-scroll.doc: If set to false, you can't scroll to cycle through workspaces from the entire bar. If set to true this behaviour is enabled.
enable-bar-scroll.description: If set to false, you can't scroll to cycle through workspaces from the entire bar. If set to true this behaviour is enabled.

reverse-scroll.label: Reverse scroll
reverse-scroll.doc: If set to false, scrolling up/left switches to the previous workspace and scrolling down/right switches to the next workspace. If set to true, the behavior is reversed.
reverse-scroll.description: If set to false, scrolling up/left switches to the previous workspace and scrolling down/right switches to the next workspace. If set to true, the behavior is reversed.

disable-markup.label: Disable markup
disable-markup.doc: If set to true, button label will escape pango markup.
disable-markup.description: If set to true, button label will escape pango markup.

current-only.label: Current only
current-only.doc: If set to true, only the active or focused workspace will be shown.
current-only.description: If set to true, only the active or focused workspace will be shown.

display-condition.label: Display condition
display-condition.doc: oneof: "show-all", "keep-named", "only-populated" Specifies the conditions for showing workspace widgets. show-all: displays widgets for all workspaces. keep-named: always displays named workspaces, irrespective of whether they contain windows or not. only-populated: only displays widgets for workspaces that have windows.
display-condition.description: oneof: "show-all", "keep-named", "only-populated" Specifies the conditions for showing workspace widgets. show-all: displays widgets for all workspaces. keep-named: always displays named workspaces, irrespective of whether they contain windows or not. only-populated: only displays widgets for workspaces that have windows.

hide-empty.label: Hide empty
hide-empty.doc: If set to true, empty workspaces will not be shown.
hide-empty.description: If set to true, empty workspaces will not be shown.

ignore-workspaces.label: Ignore workspaces
ignore-workspaces.doc: Regexes to match against workspace names. If there is a match, the workspace will not be shown.
ignore-workspaces.description: Regexes to match against workspace names. If there is a match, the workspace will not be shown.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

workspace-taskbar.label: Workspace taskbar
workspace-taskbar.doc: Contains settings for the workspace taskbar, which displays app icons within each workspace.
workspace-taskbar.description: Contains settings for the workspace taskbar, which displays app icons within each workspace.

icon-size.label: Icon size
icon-size.doc: Size of the icons in the workspace taskbar.
icon-size.description: Size of the icons in the workspace taskbar.

format-window-separator.label: What to show when window separator
format-window-separator.doc: Separator used between window representations generated by window-rewrite.
format-window-separator.description: Separator used between window representations generated by window-rewrite.

window-rewrite.label: Window rewrite
window-rewrite.doc: Rules to map window app_id and/or title to a specific string representation (e.g., an icon). Keys are regular expressions matching app_id<regex> and/or title<regex>. Values are the replacement strings, which can contain {app_id} and {title} placeholders.
window-rewrite.description: Rules to map window app_id and/or title to a specific string representation (e.g., an icon). Keys are regular expressions matching app_id<regex> and/or title<regex>. Values are the replacement strings, which can contain {app_id} and {title} placeholders.

window-rewrite-default.label: Window rewrite default
window-rewrite-default.doc: The default representation for windows that don't match any rule in window-rewrite.
window-rewrite-default.description: The default representation for windows that don't match any rule in window-rewrite.
